name: Retro Zine
description: Risograph-zine editorial system on warm khaki paper with deep forest-green accent and ink-black structure. Bebas Neue uppercase display at monstrous scale, Space Grotesk body at column-tight sizes, Caveat hand-script for personal asides. A fixed SVG grain overlay at 7% opacity reinforces the printed-paper register. 3px solid black borders, paper-on-paper offset cards, small rotations on stamps and collage pieces — the deck reads as a hand-stapled independent press publication rather than a digital presentation.
descriptionZh: 蜡纸印刷风格编辑系统，暖黄卡其色纸张 + 深森林绿强调色 + 墨黑色结构。Bebas Neue 大写展示字体 + Space Grotesk 正文 + Caveat 手写体。固定 7% 不透明度 SVG 颗粒叠加层强化印刷质感。3px 实心黑边框、纸张叠加偏移卡片、微旋转印章和拼贴片。
bestFor: 小批量 / 手工艺发布
avoidFor: 需要数码原生感或快节奏现代科技能量的场景
